Regex always matches (all groups optional), so `|| []` fallback is unreachable dead code.
Calling parseAuth() with no args now yields wrong username instead of empty string.
Calling parseHost() with no args yields wrong hostname parsed from placeholder text instead of empty.
Regex first group is optional so match() never returns null; fallback array unreachable.
For protocol-relative URLs with falsy protocol, stringify inserts placeholder text instead of empty prefix, corrupting output.
